title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Anime Casts Hiroshi Kamiya
content: The "Chayamachi Oshi Festival 2026" stage presentation for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira 's Mission: Yozakura Family ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) manga on Sunday revealed that Hiroshi Kamiya is joining the second season's cast as Kai Izumo, Kyoichiro's best friend and the president of the spy association.
author: ANN

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Tops Weekly Ranking for the Eight Time in Spring 2026 After Final Episode
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has topped the weekly Spring 2026 anime rankings for the eight time in Week 11 after its final episode. The anime had over 17% of the total votes this time, while the vote count was the highest of the season at over 9000. This was also its fourth win in a row.
author: Anime Corner

title: Pandora Hearts Manga Gets New Stage Musical
content: Jun Mochizuki 's Pandora Hearts manga is inspiring a second stage musical adaptation titled PandoraHearts Retrace Ⅱ -madness of lost memory- that will run in Tokyo from October 2-12, and in Kobe from October 16-18.
author: ANN

title: Elfaria and Zeo of Magia Vander Fight for Will in Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 Episode 11 Preview
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 has revealed the preview images and synopsis for Episode 11 (Episode 23 overall). In the previous episode, we got to see Will finally reunite with Elfaria after passing the trial. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide, with Episode 11 scheduled to premiere on June 21.
author: Anime Corner

title: Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy Anime Gets 2nd Season
content: The official website for the television anime of nonco 's Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy ( Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi ) manga announced on Sunday that production on a second season has been green-lit.
author: ANN

title: 10 New Summer 2026 Anime You Need to Watch This July (& Where to Find Them)
content: The final few anime of the Spring 2026 anime schedule are coming to their respective ends, and now it’s time to look ahead to the new wave of anime coming as part of the Summer 2026 anime schedule . This July, fans are going to be treated to a ton of cool new releases that are going to be competing for your attention.

title: 3 Details You Probably Missed in the Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Teaser
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 made waves during its run in Winter 2026, and following its conclusion, Season 4 of the anime was immediately announced. Since then, fans have naturally been expecting news about the installment, though no one expected anything so soon.
